qa_pair.question: Discover the exported model and inspect all duct pages. Which duct has the larger rectangular width-times-height section? Return only its element ID.
Discover canonical slope units and compare all pipes. Which pipe has the largest absolute slope? Return only its name.
Discover the model identity, retrieve all ducts and calculate their mean stored elevation in metres. Return one decimal digit.
Discover the model revision, identify both ducts, build and preview a graph setting their elevation to 3 metres. How many changes are proposed? Return only the integer.
Identify the supply air duct, build and preview an elevation of 3 metres, then read the duct again. What elevation does the exported snapshot still report? Return metres with one decimal digit.
Discover the documented slope units and find the drainage pipe. Build and preview a graph setting its slope to 2 percent. Return the proposed canonical ratio with two decimal digits.
Find the corridor wall and try building a slope-setting graph for it. Can that property graph be built successfully? Return True or False.
Discover the model and compare all mechanical equipment with both duct sections. Which element has the largest stored width? Return only its name.
Inspect every pipe, using pagination, and check both elevation and signed slope. Are all pipes below elevation 3 metres and positively sloped? Return True or False.
Discover the available model, find the supply air duct and attempt to build a graph setting its width to zero. What host validation error variant rejects it? Return only the variant name.
